description: Start a PDF upload. Returns {upload_id, put_url, expires_at, max_bytes}. HTTP PUT the raw PDF bytes to put_url (Content-Type: application/pdf, no auth needed — the URL is signed). The PUT response includes the validation report. Then pass upload_id to create_order. Keyless use is bounded per calling origin: 20 create_upload calls per hour, at most 5 unused uploads open at a time, and put_url expires in 2 hours — so PUT the bytes promptly and reuse an upload_id you already hold instead of creating extras. An API key (see apply_enterprise) lifts both limits.
name: create_upload
